news.title: MBS appearance, the ABEMA episode page, and a change to our October 3 plans.
news.text: We played AXIS SQUARE at VEK TOKYO on September 25. Our appearance on MBS Mainichi Broadcasting (Kansai)'s アキナのギャルしか勝たん aired on September 30, 01:59–02:29 JST (listed as September 29, 25:59–26:29). Find the ABEMA episode page in our appearances section. Our DJ appearance scheduled for October 3 has been cancelled.
